Name: Guidance
Text: Pay {1 Trade}: Scrap a card in the trade row.

Name: Processing
Text: Pay {2 Trade}: Put the next card you acquire this turn directly on top of your deck.

Name: Stealth
Text: Pay {2 Trade}: Choose a faction. You ocunt as having an additional card of that faction in play this turn.

Name: Stellar Link
Text: Pay {2 Trade}: Look at the top two cards of your deck. Put one into your discard pile and the other back on top of your deck.

Name: Tractor Beam
Text: Pay {2 Trade}: Return target base to its owner's hand.

Name: Warp
Text: Pay {2 Trade}: Draw a card, then discard a card.
